name: subagent-no-report-channel
description: Recover the result of a spawned agent whose report never reached you, now that the host delivers most reports itself (a subagent's final text as its result or completion notification; SubagentHandback in auto mode on 2.1.271+). What is left: wrapper agents that dispatch to a background job runtime (e.g. codex-rescue) and report only the hand-off, whose result sits in the runtime's state directory; thin reports outside auto mode or from a fork, recoverable from the transcript; and the transcript wedge check (tool_use with no tool_result, after looking for the agent's permission prompt in the main or lead session).
author: voitta-ai
